Working with other disciplines to make sure exterior systems fit with the overall yacht design. Supporting production and suppliers with clear technical information. Identifying technical risks and proposing smart improvements. Contributing ideas to improve quality, efficiency and manufacturability. Monitoring the technical consistency of your scope within the project. You will work on custom-built projects where every detail must match the overall design and quality standard. What Xelvin offers you A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €5,500, depending on experience.Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the full relocation process. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for engineers with experience in product design, industrial design, shipbuilding, metalwork, exterior systems or high-end technical engineering. A background in Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Naval Architecture, Shipbuilding, Furniture/Interior Technology or a related technical field. At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: industrial product design; shipbuilding or marine engineering; yacht interiors or yacht exteriors; metal structures, aluminium or stainless steel components; high-end custom engineering. Strong experience with 2D and 3D CAD software. Experience with SolidWorks, Rhino, AutoCAD, Inventor, Siemens NX, CATIA, Fusion 360 or similar software. Good understanding of manufacturability, materials and technical detailing. A strong eye for shape, finish and visual quality. Good English communication skills. Motivation to relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands. Dutch is not required. Willingness to learn Dutch over time is a plus.
